home.subtitle: Paste a reference list or upload a PDF. We extract the citations, search 5 academic databases, and score every match.

about.title: About Source Taster Web
about.webIntro: This web app verifies references online — no installation needed. Paste text or upload a PDF, we extract and check every reference against 5 academic databases.
about.extensionIntro: For checking references directly in your workflow (context menu, sidepanel), install the browser extension.
about.privacy: Your text and references are only sent to our API for processing. API keys are stored encrypted on the server.
